description: Admin power cockpit: budget safety, trend, group breakdown, node anomalies. Raw IPMI watts. Sections 1-3.

options.content: Set **Power budget (W)** in the top bar and press **Enter**. `0` = Not configured (grey, no budget line). Group Budget/Used/Remaining currently use the cluster budget.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))
vector(${power_budget_watts})

((sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) / (${power_budget_watts})) and on() (vector(${power_budget_watts}) > 0)

((${power_budget_watts}) - (sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})))) and on() (vector(${power_budget_watts}) > 0)

((${power_budget_watts} - (sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})))) / (${power_budget_watts})) and on() (vector(${power_budget_watts}) > 0)

sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

(max_over_time(((sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) * 1e12 + timestamp(sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))))[$__range:15s]) % 1e12) * 1000

count(count by (hostname) (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) or vector(0)
count(count by (hostname) (up{exporter="ipmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) or vector(0)

(count(count by (hostname) (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(count(count by (hostname) (up{exporter="ipmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) or vector(0), 1)

(count(count by (hostname) (up{exporter="ipmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) or vector(0) - count(count by (hostname) (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) or vector(0))

bottomk(1, (count by (luna_group) (count by (hostname, luna_group) (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) / clamp_min(count by (luna_group) (count by (hostname, luna_group) (up{exporter="ipmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})), 1)))
(sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

((sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) - sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} offset 15m) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} offset 15m))) / clamp_min(abs(sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} offset 15m) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} offset 15m))), 1e-9))

topk(1, (sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) - sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} offset 15m) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} offset 15m))))
(sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))
vector(${power_budget_watts})

((sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) / vector(${power_budget_watts})) and on() (vector(${power_budget_watts}) > 0)

(vector(${power_budget_watts}) - on(luna_group) group_left() (sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) and on() (vector(${power_budget_watts}) > 0)

((sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) - (sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} offset 15m) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} offset 15m)))

count by (luna_group) (count by (hostname, luna_group) (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})))

((count by (luna_group) (count by (hostname, luna_group) (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) / clamp_min(count by (luna_group) (count by (hostname, luna_group) (up{exporter="ipmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})), 1)) < bool 0.5) * 2 or ((count by (luna_group) (count by (hostname, luna_group) (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) / clamp_min(count by (luna_group) (count by (hostname, luna_group) (up{exporter="ipmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})), 1)) < bool 0.8) * 1 or on(luna_group) (count by (luna_group) (count by (hostname, luna_group) (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) * 0)

topk(50, (sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})))

((sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) - on(luna_group) group_left() quantile by (luna_group) (0.5, (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))))
